test_title: PYST 71: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. M is the immediate neighbour of O and J. J is sitting second to the right of K. L is sitting second to the right of N. Who is sitting between L and N when considered from the right of N?
solution: **Given :** Six people J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. **Explanation :** 1) M is the immediate neighbour of O and J. 2) J is sitting second to the right of K.
